title.en: Planning (Housing and Development Board Flats Authorisation) Notification 2017

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification is the Planning (Housing and Development Board Flats Authorisation) Notification 2017 and comes into operation on 15 May 2017.
3. The use of an HDB flat to provide dormitory accommodation or short‑term accommodation is authorised if the HDB lease permits such use or the Board gives written approval for such use.
